definitions.gloss: visiting a grave, paying respects at a grave
definitions.explanation: The practice of visiting the grave of a deceased family member or friend to clean the grave, offer flowers and incense, and pray.

examples.japanese: {墓参|はかまい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{墓参|はかまい}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{墓参|はかまい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{恒例|こうれい}→恒例：12597_kourei⟧になっている。
examples.english: It's our family tradition to visit the grave together during Obon.

notes:
USAGE:
Also used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {墓参|はかまい}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ / {墓参|はかまい}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. The polite form お{墓参|はかまい}り is also common.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Grave visits are an important part of Japanese family life. The main occasions are:
- ⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧ (mid-August) — when spirits of ancestors are believed to return
- ⟦お{彼岸|ひがん}→お彼岸：08933_ohigan⟧ (spring and autumn equinox periods)
- ⟦{命日|めいにち}→命日：17539_meinichi⟧ (death anniversary)
- ⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧ (New Year period)

During {墓参|はかまい}り, people typically clean the gravestone, offer ⟦{線香|せんこう}→線香：09995_senkou⟧ (incense), ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (flowers), and ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (water), and pray.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {墓参|はかまい}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go visit a grave)
- お{墓参|はかまい}り (polite form)
